Subject: A few first steps on RUNECLAW
Preheader: The Arena, a sealed call, and the Study Room — whenever you’re ready.

Hello,

Your RUNECLAW account has been sitting ready. Here are three concrete ways to use it — all on paper or on public pages, with no exchange keys.

1. Open the Paper Trading Arena and place a paper trade, or follow a strategy agent on paper inside your own risk limits. Everyone starts with the same virtual balance, at live market prices.
   https://www.humanoid-traders.com/arena

2. Verify a public call yourself. Every call is sealed when it is made, before the market moves. You can check that record in your own browser.
   https://www.humanoid-traders.com/provable

3. Sit with a Study Room lesson, or take that day’s Daily Duel card. Both are practice. Neither is advice.
   https://www.humanoid-traders.com/learn
   https://www.humanoid-traders.com/duel

Whenever you’re ready, the Arena is the most direct next step.

Open the Arena
https://www.humanoid-traders.com/arena
